label: SYNTHETIC
note: The pack manifest of the fintech pack (PCK-02, ruling A333; settles the hash-pin of EVD-06, A320). It lists each pack file the core loads with its SHA-256 and names the evidence-mapping id and the reconciliation rule-set id the core expects, so the core hard-codes neither (INV-14). The core loads through it and refuses a mismatch. A path is relative to the pack directory (packs/). `expected` ids are `<id>@<version>` exactly as the file carries them (mapping_id and version, ruleset_id and version). Every file of a listed kind must be listed: an unlisted file is a packcheck failure. Hash-pinned now, signatures later (A320). Any edit to a listed file needs its SHA-256 updated here, in the same pull request: `sha256sum <file>` gives it. Not yet listed (no consumer yet): graphs, limits, lexicons, templates, schemas, and injection_patterns.v1.json (EVD-06, noema#688; add it with its kind when that merges).
